topics.title: Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) & Microfluidic Flow Control
topics.objective: Design laminar flow delivery channels maintaining optimal root zone oxygenation and nutrient film depths.
topics.example: flow_rate_lpm = 1.5 # liters per minute per gully
topics.exercise: Calculate pump head pressure and distribution manifold diameters ensuring uniform nutrient delivery across 20 tiers.

topics.title: Ion-Selective Electrode (ISE) Closed-Loop Dosing
topics.objective: Measure individual nitrate, potassium, and calcium ions in recirculating reservoir water for precision micro-dosing.
topics.exercise: Write a micro-controller dosing algorithm preventing nutrient lockup and calcium precipitate formation.

topics.title: Dynamic LED Photobiology & Blue/Far-Red Spectral Ratios
topics.objective: Modulate photosynthetic photon flux density (PPFD) and far-red wavelengths to steer plant morphogenesis and leaf expansion.
topics.exercise: Formulate a dynamic 16-hour diurnal light recipe shifting spectrum from vegetative growth to anthocyanin accumulation.

topics.title: Edge Computer Vision & Automated Canopy Stress Detection
topics.objective: Deploy high-resolution RGB and multispectral cameras to identify early tip-burn, chlorosis, and leaf transpiration stress.
topics.exercise: Build an image classification pipeline running on edge hardware flagging leaf tip-burn prior to visual human detection.

topics.title: HVAC Dehumidification & Heat Recovery Integration
topics.objective: Balance latent heat loads from dense crop transpiration using high-efficiency desiccant dehumidifiers and water recycling.
topics.exercise: Design a closed-loop water recovery system recycling 95% of transpired moisture back into reverse osmosis tanks.
